completion_promises.criterion_text: Test boots tutor adapter, queries agent-registry KV, finds gcse-tutor row with the correct manifest payload.
completion_promises.evidence: test_jarvis_discovers_gcse_tutor_via_live_kv constructs NATSAdapter with the production _tutor_manifest_factory(agent_id='gcse-tutor'), calls adapter.start() against a live nats-server subprocess, then opens a sidecar NATSKVManifestRegistry on the same agent-registry bucket and asserts: stored.agent_id == 'gcse-tutor', name/template/trust_tier match the manifest, len(stored.intents) >= 1 with at least one 'tutoring.*' intent, and all four MCP tools (tutor_start_session, tutor_turn, tutor_session_status, tutor_session_end) are present in stored.tools.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Test asserts capability resolution for tutor_start_session returns gcse-tutor (Decision 1 regression guard — discovery does NOT depend on stub yaml).
completion_promises.evidence: After verifying the row, the same test calls consumer_registry.find_by_tool('tutor_start_session') — the same KV-backed surface jarvis's LiveCapabilitiesRegistry consumes (capabilities_registry.py L575-590) — and asserts the result is non-empty AND that 'gcse-tutor' is in the candidate agent_ids list. The resolver call uses NATSKVManifestRegistry directly because jarvis is not importable from this repo; the task explicitly permits this stand-in ('mock the resolver shape: read agent-registry KV directly').

completion_promises.criterion_text: Test tears down tutor and asserts the KV row is removed within 30s.
completion_promises.evidence: After the resolver assertions, the test calls adapter.stop() and then opens a fresh observer connection to poll the agent-registry bucket. A while-loop with a 30.0s deadline calls observer_registry.get(manifest.agent_id) every 100ms and breaks when the result is None; if the deadline elapses with the row still present, pytest.fail() is invoked with a message naming the Decision 1 graceful-deregister contract. Final assertions confirm adapter.is_ready is False and adapter.active_tasks == 0.

The assertion then checks the production-side adapter modules the test imports (study_tutor.adapters.nats_adapter, study_tutor.adapters.manifest, study_tutor.adapters.command_router) by reading each module's __file__ and asserting 'stub_capabilities' does not appear in the source. AST-based scanning prevents false positives from comments while still catching imports/paths.
